convert_se3_log_to_matrix: convert a batch of 6D SE(3) logarithmic vectors to 4x4 transformation matrices using se3_exp_map
convert_se3_matrix_to_log: convert a batch of 4x4 SE(3) transformation matrices to 6D logarithmic vectors using se3_log_map
compute_se3_V_matrix: compute the SE(3) V matrix from log rotation, hat, hat square, and rotation angles
compute_se3_V_input: compute the input variables needed for the SE(3) V matrix from a log rotation tensor
roundtrip_se3_transform: verify se3_exp_map and se3_log_map are inverses by converting a log transform to matrix and back
